mapper.select: SELECT * FROM torn_stock_market_round WHERE round_status = 'COMPLETED' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY round_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM torn_stock_market_round WHERE round_time <= #{maxRoundTime} AND round_status IN ('PENDING', 'BUILDING_BAR', 'BUILDING_FEATURE', 'WAITING_DATA', 'FAILED_RETRYABLE', 'READY', 'PROCESSING') AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY round_time ASC
SELECT * FROM torn_stock_market_round WHERE round_time = #{roundTime} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO torn_stock_market_round (round_time, round_status, bar_build_version, feature_version, buy_rule_version, sell_rule_version, allocation_rule_version, message_rule_version, expected_stock_count, usable_stock_count, attempt_count, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{round.roundTime}, 'PENDING', #{round.barBuildVersion}, #{round.featureVersion}, #{round.buyRuleVersion}, #{round.sellRuleVersion}, #{round.allocationRuleVersion}, #{round.messageRuleVersion}, 0, 0, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (round_time) WHERE deleted = 0 DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO torn_stock_market_round (round_time, round_status, bar_build_version, feature_version, buy_rule_version, sell_rule_version, allocation_rule_version, message_rule_version, expected_stock_count, usable_stock_count, attempt_count, started_at, completed_at, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{round.roundTime}, #{round.roundStatus}, #{round.barBuildVersion}, #{round.featureVersion}, #{round.buyRuleVersion}, #{round.sellRuleVersion}, #{round.allocationRuleVersion}, #{round.messageRuleVersion}, #{round.expectedStockCount}, #{round.usableStockCount}, #{round.attemptCount}, #{round.startedAt}, #{round.completedAt}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ON CONFLICT (round_time) WHERE deleted = 0 DO UPDATE SET round_status = EXCLUDED.round_status, bar_build_version = EXCLUDED.bar_build_version, feature_version = EXCLUDED.feature_version, expected_stock_count = EXCLUDED.expected_stock_count, usable_stock_count = EXCLUDED.usable_stock_count, started_at = COALESCE(torn_stock_market_round.started_at, EXCLUDED.started_at), completed_at = EXCLUDED.completed_at, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE torn_stock_market_round.round_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED_FINAL')
